nodes.title: Asana API request
nodes.description: Call any Asana API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/tags?workspace=<workspace gid>". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read tasks, projects, sections, users, workspaces, teams, tags, stories, portfolios, goals and similar resources (no webhooks, attachments, exports or audit logs).

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/tags?workspace=<workspace gid>"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
